Come study with us
Our undergraduate and postgraduate aerospace, mechanical, and mechatronic engineering degrees develop your skills in innovative fields such as aircraft design, robotics, and intelligent systems. Accredited by Engineers Australia and other major professional engineering institutions, our programs emphasise hands-on learning and cutting-edge research, equipping graduates to thrive in diverse, fast-evolving industries.
Our graduates are highly sought after and have held influential positions across diverse organisations and companies, including Boeing, NASA JPL, F1 racing teams, leading research groups, universities, and many more companies.

Our innovative research

Designing the next generation of robotics, machinery and materials
With strong industry partnerships, we collaborate with leading organisations to drive advancements in sustainable energy, intelligent systems, and high-performance materials.
By merging practical applications with cutting-edge breakthroughs, we develop technologies that tackle urgent global challenges and meet the evolving needs of society.
Our student teams
Discover our dynamic student teams, world champions in rocketry, motorsport, and aircraft design, competing in international competitions.
